summary: Iteration 20 — verified P2 dashboard aggregate changes. The /api/dashboard endpoint now derives `unpaid_expense_balance` and `total_payments_ytd` from the canonical paid_map plus the paid=True override (server.py:2348-2364). 7 new tests covering scenarios A (paid=True contributes to Paid YTD + removes itself from Open Balance), B (mixed partial-payment + paid=True), and C (unapply round-trip via PATCH applied_expense_ids=[] & allocations=[]) all PASS. iter-18 (16) + iter-19 (4) regression suite remains 20/20 GREEN. Net: 27/27 PASS. No regressions, no fixes required.

verification_results.A1_paid_true_contributes_to_paid_ytd: PASS — Two expenses created (e1 $100 paid=False, e2 $200 paid=True). Dashboard delta: total_payments_ytd += $200 (from e2), unpaid_expense_balance += $100 (only e1).
verification_results.A2_toggle_e1_to_paid_true: PASS — After PATCH /api/expenses/{e1} paid=True: ytd delta = $300, open delta = $0.
verification_results.A3_toggle_e1_back_to_unpaid: PASS — After PATCH paid=False: dashboard reverts to A1 deltas ($200 / $100).
verification_results.B1_partial_payment_60_via_waterfall: PASS — POST $60 covering e1 → ytd delta = $60, open delta = $40 (e1 remaining) + $200 (e2) = $240.
verification_results.B2_toggle_e2_to_paid_true_with_partial_e: PASS — After PATCH e2 paid=True: ytd delta = $60 + $200 = $260, open delta = $40 (only the residual on e1).
verification_results.C1_payment_marks_expense_paid: PASS — POST $100 covering e1 $100 → e1.paid=True, balance_due=$0.
verification_results.C2_unapply_via_empty_lists: PASS — PATCH payment with applied_expense_ids=[] AND allocations=[] → e1.paid flipped back to False, balance_due restored to $100. _refresh_expense_paid_flags ran correctly (server.py:1512-1556).

action_items: No action items. P2 dashboard aggregate change is correct and the unapply path remains regression-free.
Optional follow-up (unchanged): server.py is now 3506 lines — consider splitting into per-resource routers (dashboard, payments, expenses, calendar).
critical_code_review_comments: Good: dashboard() at server.py:2326-2399 now reads from the same canonical paid_map used by /api/expenses, so the dashboard tile values are guaranteed to agree with the per-athlete views.

Good: the paid=True override logic at server.py:2359-2363 is symmetric — if paid=true but the row's effective_paid is below amount, it bumps effective_paid up to amount. min(paid, amt) on line 2363 also defends against payment-overflow (e.g. $120 paid on $100 expense) so Paid YTD never exceeds total expense amounts.

Good: unapply path at update_payment (server.py:1512-1556) snapshots existing.applied_expense_ids and existing.allocations BEFORE the update and unions them into affected_ids — so when client PATCHes empty arrays, every previously-covered expense is re-evaluated and paid flag flips back correctly.

Minor (not introduced this pass): total_expenses and total_payments local variables on lines 2335-2341 are computed but no longer used directly in the response (only total_payments_ytd / total_expenses_ytd are returned, and total_payments_ytd now uses paid_from_expenses). The leftover total_payments variable is dead code — safe to remove for clarity but not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Each test class auto-creates and cleans up its own sandbox (athletes, expenses, payments) prefixed TEST_iter20_. Baseline dashboard snapshot is used so tests assert on deltas, never absolute values — safe to run concurrently with other data on smoke@test.com.
